descriptions.alerts: Price, position and account conditions that notify you wherever you already read messages.
descriptions.help: The built-in manual for every page in the product.
descriptions.multiChart: Four periods of one symbol side by side, with the crosshair and time window linked.
descriptions.proChart: One symbol on a professional chart: drawing tools, indicators, Heikin-Ashi, volume profile and bar replay.
descriptions.warehouse: The bars stored on this machine, which backtests and factor runs read instead of an API.

instructions.alerts: Create a rule, then enable the local scheduler — rules are only evaluated while it runs. Delivery also needs a configured channel.
instructions.help: Read it once from the top, then come back from any page when a feature is hard to find.
instructions.multiChart: Choose the four periods; with linking on, the crosshair and the visible window move across every cell at once.
instructions.proChart: Pick a symbol and a period, then use the toolbar to draw, switch indicators, or replay history bar by bar.
instructions.warehouse: Fetch or import bars here, then select the warehouse as the data source to run offline on the same bars.
